title: There Goes the Neighborhood? The Local Impacts of State Policies that Override Municipal Zoning
title_zh: 邻里何去何从？州政策超越市镇区划的地方影响
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Zoning regulations drive rising regional housing costs and residential segregation in the United States. In response, governments are passing laws to override local regulations that limit housing density, despite entrenched opposition from incumbent residents. We study how residents living near housing permitted under one such law, Massachusetts’ Chapter 40B, are affected by and respond to this new, denser housing. Exploiting hyperlocal variation in proximity to 40B developments, we find that the average development does not affect these residents’ property values (95% CI: [–0.4%, 2.4%]). For larger developments that do decrease values, outmigration and political responses are small or non-existent.
abstract_zh: 美国的分区法规推高了地区住房成本并加剧了居住隔离。为此，各州政府正通过立法来推翻限制住房密度的地方法规，尽管面临现有居民的强烈反对。我们研究了在马萨诸塞州《第40B章》这类法律许可下，居住在新建高密度住房附近的居民如何受到这些住房的影响并作出反应。通过利用与40B开发项目邻近程度的超本地化差异，我们发现平均而言，这些开发项目并未影响周边居民的房产价值（95%置信区间：[–0.4%, 2.4%]）。对于确实导致价值下降的大型开发项目，居民的迁出和政治回应微乎其微甚至不存在。

title: Willingness to Pay for Workplace Amenities
title_zh: 工作场所便利设施的支付意愿
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We develop a revealed preference approach to measure the value of workplace amenities by analyzing how variation in non-wage job attributes affects excess mass in the earnings distribution at budget discontinuities. The approach formalizes the idea that workers respond less to monetary incentives when amenities constitute a larger share of total compensation. Applying this method to workplace safety during COVID-19 waves, we find that workers are willing to sacrifice 9% of their earnings to reduce weekly fatality risks by one in 100,000. The findings suggest that conventional hedonic regressions substantially underestimate the value of workplace safety.

title_zh: 他人经历的早期劳动力市场遭遇会对男性工作意愿造成永久性创伤
official: 官方在线 2026-07-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Labour force participation among prime-aged American men has fallen for over half a century, and standard explanations leave much of the decline unaccounted for. This column combines panel and survey data to show that the labour markets these men experienced while growing up shaped their willingness to work decades later. These effects survive childhood moves across states and likely operate through men’s beliefs about whether work will pay off. If temporary downturns in labour demand can persistently influence labour supply, anchoring expectations about employment, not just inflation, may have a place in macroeconomic policy.

title: Frontier Markets: Analyzing Drivers of Market Growth and Sovereign Risks
title_zh: 前沿市场：市场增长与主权风险的驱动因素分析
authors: Younes Takki Chebihi & Naoya Kato & Maxwell Kushnir & Andreja Lenarcic & Yinhao Sun & Mr. Bilal Tabti
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Frontier Market (FM) status serves as a steppingstone for Low-Income Countries (LICs) aspiring to become Emerging Markets (EMs). Since the concept first emerged over three decades ago, FMs have gained substantial investment appeal, particularly after the 2008 Global Financial Crisis. At the same time, the recent series of global shocks starting with the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the countries’ persistent vulnerabilities. This paper seeks to deepen our understanding of FMs by offering new analysis on the determinants of frontier market status and, using a dynamic country sample, examining the factors that help LICs attain and lose FM status. It finds that building robust macroeconomic fundamentals and ensuring good governance are critical for becoming an FM. In addition, the paper identifies flexible exchange rates, substantial official reserve buffers, and relatively low public debt and deficit levels as key contributors to lessening the sensitivity of FMs’ sovereign spreads to changes in global financial conditions.
abstract_zh: 前沿市场（FM）地位是低收入国家（LICs）迈向新兴市场（EMs）的跳板。自三十多年前这一概念首次提出以来，FM已获得显著的投资吸引力，尤其是在2008年全球金融危机之后。与此同时，从新冠疫情开始的一系列近期全球冲击凸显了这些国家持续存在的脆弱性。本文旨在通过提供关于前沿市场地位决定因素的新分析，并利用动态国家样本，考察帮助低收入国家获得和失去FM地位的因素，从而加深我们对FM的理解。研究发现，构建稳健的宏观经济基本面并确保良好的治理是成为FM的关键。此外，本文指出，灵活的汇率制度、充足的外汇储备缓冲、以及相对较低的公共债务和赤字水平，是降低FM主权利差对全球金融状况变化敏感性的关键因素。

title: Improving robust decisions with data
title_zh: 利用数据改进稳健决策
official: 卷期日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A decision‐maker faces uncertainty governed by a data‐generating process (DGP), which is only known to belong to a set of sequences of independent but possibly non‐identical distributions. A robust decision maximizes the expected payoff against the worst possible DGP in this set. This paper characterizes when and how such robust decisions can be objectively improved with data; that is, can yield higher expected payoffs under the true DGP regardless of which DGP is the truth. It further develops simple and novel inference procedures that achieve such improvement, while common methods (e.g., maximum likelihood) may fail to do so.
abstract_zh: 决策者面临由数据生成过程（DGP）主导的不确定性，该过程仅已知属于一组独立但可能非同分布序列的集合。稳健决策旨在最大化该集合中最差可能DGP下的期望收益。本文刻画了此类稳健决策何时以及如何能够通过数据实现客观改进——即无论真实DGP为何，均能在真实DGP下获得更高期望收益。进一步地，本文提出了实现此类改进的简洁新颖推断方法，而常见方法（如极大似然估计）可能无法达成这一目标。

abstract: We examine child mental health treatment surrounding three school milestones in Taiwan: Middle school entry, high stakes testing for high school entrance, and college entrance exams. Using age cutoffs for school entry, we compare August-born to September-born children since the August-born reach each milestone one year earlier. Comparing adjacent cohorts of children born in the same month yields similar estimates. We find that entry into middle school increases mental health prescribing of antidepressant, anti-anxiety, and antipsychotic medications. Use of psychiatric medications falls sharply following high-stakes tests. Effects are stronger in counties where parents and children have higher educational aspirations.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文考察了台湾地区三个学校关键节点——初中入学、高中入学高利害考试及大学入学考试——对儿童心理健康治疗的影响。利用入学年龄截止日期，我们比较了8月出生与9月出生的儿童，因为8月出生的儿童比9月出生的儿童早一年经历每个关键节点。对同月出生的相邻队列儿童进行比较，得出了相似的估计结果。我们发现，初中入学增加了抗抑郁药、抗焦虑药和抗精神病药等心理健康药物的处方量。高利害考试后，精神科药物的使用量急剧下降。在父母和子女教育期望更高的县市，这种效应更为显著。

title: Corrected Forecast Combinations
title_zh: 修正后的预测组合
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper proposes corrected forecast combinations when the original combined forecast errors are serially dependent. Motivated by the classic Bates and Granger (1969) example, we show that combined forecast errors can be strongly autocorrelated and that a simple correction - adding a fraction of the previous combined error to the next-period combined forecast - can deliver sizable improvements in forecast accuracy, often exceeding the original gains from combining. We formalize the approach within the conditional-risk framework of Gibbs and Vasnev (2024), in which the combined error decomposes into a predictable component (measurable at the forecast origin) and an innovation. We then link this correction to efficient estimation of combination weights under time-series dependence via GLS, allowing joint estimation of weights and an error-covariance structure. Using the U.S. Survey of Professional Forecasters for major macroeconomic indices across various subsamples (including pre/post-2000, GFC, and COVID), we find that a parsimonious correction of the mean forecast with a coefficient around 0.5 is a robust starting point and often yields material improvements in forecast accuracy. For optimal-weight forecasts, the correction substantially mitigates the forecast combination puzzle by turning poorly performing out-of-sample optimal-weight combinations into competitive forecasts.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种修正的组合预测方法，适用于原始组合预测误差存在序列相关性的情形。受Bates和Granger（1969）经典案例的启发，我们证明组合预测误差可能呈现强自相关性，而一个简单的修正——将上一期组合误差的一部分加入下一期组合预测——能够显著提升预测精度，其改进幅度往往超过组合本身带来的原始收益。我们在Gibbs和Vasnev（2024）的条件风险框架内对该方法进行了形式化处理，在该框架中，组合误差可分解为可预测成分（在预测起点可测）和创新项。随后，我们将该修正与时间序列依赖条件下通过广义最小二乘法对组合权重的高效估计联系起来，从而实现对权重与误差协方差结构的联合估计。基于美国专业预测者调查中主要宏观经济指标在不同子样本（包括2000年前后、全球金融危机及新冠疫情期间）的数据，我们发现，对均值预测采用系数约为0.5的简约修正是一个稳健的起点，且通常能带来预测精度的实质性提升。对于最优权重预测而言，该修正通过将表现不佳的样本外最优权重组合转化为具有竞争力的预测，显著缓解了预测组合难题。

title: Dollar Erosion: Understanding the Loss of Reserve Currency Status
title_zh: 美元侵蚀：理解储备货币地位的丧失
authors: Zhengyang Jiang, Arvind Krishnamurthy, Hanno Lustig, Robert J. Richmond
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We quantify the impact of the loss of reserve currency status in goods and asset markets. In goods markets, the loss of seigniorage (1% of GDP per annum) makes American households spend less, mostly on U.S. goods, leaving an excess supply of U.S. goods to be cleared by a real depreciation of the dollar. The larger the home bias and the lower the elasticity of substitution between home and foreign goods, the larger the required depreciation. Standard parameters imply an 8.8% real depreciation of the dollar. In asset markets, about 50% of GDP in dollar bonds must be reabsorbed by home investors, raising the U.S. real interest rate. Standard parameters imply a 90 basis points rise, leading to an aggregate wealth loss of roughly one year of U.S. GDP.
abstract_zh: 我们量化了失去商品和资产市场储备货币地位的影响。在商品市场中，铸币税收益的丧失（每年占GDP的1%）导致美国家庭减少支出，其中大部分支出削减针对美国商品，从而产生美国商品的超额供给，需通过美元实际贬值来出清。本国偏好越强、本国与外国商品之间的替代弹性越低，所需的贬值幅度就越大。标准参数设定下，美元需实际贬值8.8%。在资产市场中，约50% GDP规模的美元债券必须由国内投资者重新吸收，这将推高美国实际利率。标准参数设定下，利率将上升90个基点，导致总财富损失约为美国一年GDP的规模。

title: Quote Competition in Corporate Bonds
title_zh: 公司债券中的报价竞争
authors: TERRENCE HENDERSHOTT, DAN LI, DMITRY LIVDAN, NORMAN SCHÜRHOFF, KUMAR VENKATARAMAN
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Dealer quotes in corporate bonds, though indicative, lower trading costs and increase trading volume. Dealers offering higher quality quotes attract more order flow and execute trades at favorable prices. Dealers advertise quotes to manage their inventories and attract orders from nonrelationship clients. However, quote competition is imperfect. The best quotes often fail to attract orders, and trade‐throughs are common. Nevertheless, quote competition is important as clients exploit quotes from other dealers in negotiations, forcing dealers with lower quality quotes to offer price improvements. Quoting is not a zero‐sum game, as more active bond‐level quoting leads to more bond‐level trading.
abstract_zh: 公司债券中的交易商报价虽为指示性报价，却能降低交易成本并提升交易量。提供更优质报价的交易商能吸引更多订单流，并以有利价格执行交易。交易商通过报价来管理库存并吸引非关系型客户的订单。然而，报价竞争并不完美。最优报价往往未能吸引订单，且"穿透交易"现象普遍存在。尽管如此，报价竞争仍至关重要——客户会在谈判中利用其他交易商的报价，迫使报价质量较低的交易商提供价格改善。报价并非零和博弈，因为更活跃的债券层面报价会带来更多债券层面交易。
